column1: # Terms the deliverable check looks for. One per line: the kind, a tab, the term. Matched whole-word and ignoring
#   old-name       a name the company no longer uses; a finding prints it
#   confidential   a name under NDA; a finding prints neither the term nor its context
#   guess          a word that marks an unchecked claim, such as probably; a finding prints it
#   source-tag     a tag that names a source in the files of sourced.txt, besides source:
